questions.question: What is the heart?
options: A muscle that pumps blood throughout the body
questions.explanation: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood throughout the body via the circulatory system.

questions.question: What are the four chambers of the heart?
options: Left atrium, right atrium, left ventricle, right ventricle
Upper chamber, lower chamber, side chamber, back chamber
Aorta, vena cava, pulmonary artery, pulmonary vein
questions.explanation: The four chambers of the heart are left atrium, right atrium, left ventricle, and right ventricle.

questions.question: What is blood pressure?
options: The force of blood against artery walls
The amount of blood in the body
questions.explanation: Blood pressure is the force of blood pushing against the walls of arteries as the heart pumps.

questions.question: What is a heart attack?
options: A blockage of blood flow to the heart muscle
questions.explanation: A heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart muscle is blocked, usually by a blood clot.

questions.question: What is the aorta?
options: The main artery that carries blood from the heart
A blood vessel in the leg
questions.explanation: The aorta is the main artery that carries oxygenated blood from the heart to the rest of the body.
